import os, re
terms = [
    "crustacean", "crustaceans",
    "crab", "crabs",
    "lobster", "lobsters",
    "shrimp", "shrimps",
    "prawn", "prawns",
    "barnacle", "barnacles",
    "copepod", "copepods",
    "isopod", "isopods",
    "amphipod", "amphipods",
    "krill",
    "decapod", "decapods",
    "malacostracan", "malacostracans",
    "branchiopod", "branchiopods",
    "ostracod", "ostracods",
    "crayfish"
]
pat = re.compile(r"(" + "|".join(re.escape(t) for t in terms) + r")", re.IGNORECASE)
base = "/tmp/ppt_ocr"
slides_with_matches = []
for fname in sorted(os.listdir(base)):
    if not fname.endswith('.txt'):
        continue
    full = os.path.join(base, fname)
    with open(full, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
        text = f.read()
    if pat.search(text):
        # Extract slide number from filename like slide-6.txt
        m = re.search(r'slide-(\d+)\.txt', fname)
        if m:
            slides_with_matches.append(int(m.group(1)))
print("Slides with crustacean mentions:", slides_with_matches)
print("Count:", len(slides_with_matches))
